body:
Part of #36. Plan step **P04**. Synthetic implementation may proceed after P01 (#38) while P02 (#39)/P03 (#40) are pending. Real-data integration and completion also require P03 (#40); synthetic passing tests alone cannot close this issue.

Blocked by: #38, #40. These are completion dependencies; synthetic groundwork exceptions are stated below.

## Outcome

One service-side calculation produces product contributions, daily trend and monthly total using the same recognized lines and cost-covered population. The interface shows how each product generated its estimated profit without implementing money formulas in React.

## Work and acceptance

- [ ] First pin independent product/overall expectations in focused tests. Proposed simple gross-profit oracle, subject to P01 (#38): product A sells 2 pieces at net 100 each with historical unit cost 60; B sells 1 at net 50 with cost 30. A profit=80, B=20, monthly=100. Returning one A with evidenced original cost gives A=40 and monthly=60. Adding product C net sales=40 with missing cost leaves covered profit=60, makes coverage partial and withholds an unqualified total. Fixture prices are synthetic, not source-field assumptions.
- [ ] Reuse `calculateSales` and `estimateGrossResult` in `src/analytics/sales.ts` and `costs.ts`; aggregate their validated components rather than copying formulas into reporting/UI.
- [ ] Extend existing report contracts/display/query at the smallest useful seam. Product rows need stable identity/display, separately unit-aware sold/returned/net quantities, net sales, covered sales/cost/profit/margin, exclusions and coverage. Exact report fields and operation signatures are settled in P01 (#38).
- [ ] Compute daily profit and market total from the same scoped lines. The complete product set and complete day set each reconcile to the overall figure before display rounding. Keep full-sales and cost-covered-sales fields distinguishable. Paginated, searched or top-ranked subsets must never replace market-wide totals.
- [ ] Preserve negative contributions, returns-only months, zero/nonpositive margin denominators, fractional quantities and cost changes within a month. Missing costs do not become zero or disappear from exposure. Reconcile display rounding explicitly without changing source/calculation precision.
- [ ] Keep period, dataset, mapping, calculation version and app revision pinned across summary/product/detail/export. Reject or visibly mark stale context; selecting another month must not mix old detail with new totals.
- [ ] Make the gross-profit experience independent of expense completeness. Preserve the existing expense/operating report paths and accepted report semantics.
- [ ] Extend saved report and Excel output through the existing paths. Older versions remain readable and immutable; version any persisted shape change and test reopening/export after refresh and restart.
- [ ] After P03 (#40), run the same comparisons against the approved real population and independently reconciled expected results.

## Existing files and tests

[src/analytics/costs.ts](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/src/analytics/costs.ts), `src/reports/query.ts`, `contracts.ts`, `display.ts`, `versions.ts`, `export.ts`. Extend `tests/unit/cost-coverage.test.ts`, `return-cost.test.ts`, `decimal-boundaries.test.ts` and integration tests for cost provenance, report display/revisions and Excel. A focused product-profit test file is appropriate only for the new aggregation contract.

## Exit gate

Line evidence → product → daily/monthly total → pinned report → Excel reconcile with explicit coverage and consistent versions. Independent fixtures and approved real comparisons pass; unchanged expense/recovery behavior is protected. A02/A03/A04 evidence is linked.

## Execution and evidence

This is a planning backlog, not an instruction to start implementation. First settle the named decisions in P01 (#38) with the user. For each behavioral change, expose the missing contract with a focused failing test, record the actual failure, make the smallest implementation change, and run the relevant checks. Reuse the existing Vitest, Playwright packaged-desktop and synthetic SQL harness; do not create a new orchestration framework.

Use coherent Conventional Commits (`test:`, `feat:`/`fix:`, then evidence as needed). Record the task/gate, commit/build, opaque fixture/source batch, environment, command/procedure, expected and actual result, evidence location and remaining limits. Synthetic success is not source validation; macOS success is not Windows acceptance. Preserve unrelated work and accepted reports. Source access and production rollout retain their separate authorization boundaries.
title: [P1] Add reconcilable product and overall gross-profit reports
